release_notes:
v2.0.5832 Feature Update:
- New Advance Mode in QA window: checkbox to stay in drawing mode (XML only) without pressing W for each box.
- New Label Visibility List: checkboxes to show/hide shapes by label; new labels added automatically with visible checked.
- Fixed crash on refresh_legend by replacing with new label visibility list.
- Enhanced mode switching: Advance Mode auto-disabled in JSON.
